historical_allocation_model.meaning: Conditional initial chunks and module setup reuse include observed phase-to-supervisor role residuals. Unobserved overhead, later work stealing and future variance are not bounded; not timing qualification.
historical_allocation_model.planning_score_rule: Ceiling to whole seconds of the largest coherent phase path plus its observed maximum phase-to-supervisor role residual; planning only, not a timing bound or qualification; raw scores can regress within rounded buckets
historical_allocation_model.planning_score_scope: 9 complete cohorts only; raw partial scores, explicit unknowns and separately derived stress are in scoped_allocation.shards

historical_scoped_allocation.meaning: Raw partial scores stay null where observations are missing. The separate derived stress reserves one unknown case using other complete observations and dispatch maxima; it is not a measured complete cohort or timing qualification. Offsets align planning budgets only. Planning offsets do not set actual coverage or timing thresholds, worker counts or test outcomes; required CI policy enforces them independently.
